requirement: Collect a full list of requirements
deliverable: A numbered, sourced requirements register that every later artefact traces back to.

requirement: Review the repo line by line; link official sources; flag irregularities
deliverable: Repository audit with the source for every claim and an explicit irregularities list.
note: Repo contained one commit and a 5-byte README; no data, no site.

requirement: Suggest site improvements that improve decision making
deliverable: Ranked suggestions with effort / impact / risk and a recommended path.

requirement: Dedicated suggestions section that can be reviewed before implementing
deliverable: A review surface with adopt / test / reject states and dependencies, so a path is chosen before code changes.

requirement: A clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision
deliverable: A decision-question register separating what we know, what we do not know, and what would answer it.

requirement: Suggest investigations that discover missing information
deliverable: Each open question names the specific artefact or feed that would resolve it.

requirement: Originate our own NFL lines
deliverable: A documented line-origination method (power rating -> spread -> total -> price) with validation gates.
note: Cannot be validated without historical odds and outcomes, which are not ingested.

requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
deliverable: A signal catalogue, each signal tied to an official data field and a hypothesis.

requirement: Run it as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top strategies
deliverable: A scoring rule that survives multiple-comparisons correction and prevents luck from winning.

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player-prop combinations
deliverable: Separate gate sets per bet shape, because parlays and props fail for different reasons.

requirement: Every strategy must pass validation gates
deliverable: Ten named gates, each with an explicit pass threshold and a fail action.

requirement: Determine correlation values
deliverable: Measured correlations with confidence intervals, plus the limits of what a 32-team snapshot can prove.
note: Cross-sectional correlations computed; event-level prop correlation is NOT computable from current data.

requirement: Remove luck from the equation; reward skill-based strategies
deliverable: A luck-adjustment layer: sample-size floors, variance decomposition, and a false-discovery test.

requirement: Track injuries
deliverable: A structured injury feed carrying practice status and game status per player per club.
note: Week 10 2026 snapshot verified row by row against nfl.com/injuries.

requirement: Know defensive deficiencies caused by 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacements
deliverable: Depth-string resolution: who is the starter, who is the next man up, how many strings deep the drop goes.
note: Depth resolution completed for 2 of 32 clubs (KC, SEA) because those were the only official depth charts captured.

requirement: Apply the same depth analysis to offenses using starters or backups
deliverable: Offensive depth-string table with positional criticality weighting.

requirement: Executive summary of important details
deliverable: A one-page summary of state, findings, limits and decisions required.

requirement: No manual input from the owner
deliverable: All content generated and committed by the agent; every step reproducible via tools/.

requirement: Verify line by line against official trusted sources; link them
deliverable: Every table row carries a source_url to an official property, or is left blank and flagged.

requirement: Never infer or fill in values; leave unconfirmed cells blank and flag them
deliverable: Unverified cells are empty and appear on the Flagged for Review page.
note: 209 injury rows and 16 clubs' depth charts are affected and disclosed.

requirement: Coordinate with parallel sessions via COORDINATION.md
deliverable: A shared task board with claims, scopes, handoff rules and a 60-minute staleness rule.

requirement: Create a GitHub Pages site with clean landing page and category subpages
deliverable: Static site, no external CDN, nav on every page, built from the repo root.

requirement: Present every entry and finding in readable tables with analysis
deliverable: Tables with source columns on every page, plus an interpretation row/section.

requirement: Open a PR to main, merge it, and confirm Pages deploys
deliverable: PR with summary, sources and flagged irregularities; merge; deploy verification.

requirement: Publish flagged irregularities on a labelled page
deliverable: A dedicated Flagged for Review page with source links for each item.
